claim:ci-approve-bot-runs.statement: With approveBotRuns on, approve-bot-runs approves each pull_request run of the repository that waits for approval on the head. It looks again until a quiet period of 30 s follows the last approval, or until 3 minutes pass. It fails only when runs waited and it approved none. It approves no run of a fork and no run of another head.
claim:ci-approve-bot-runs.falsifier: A fake-API fixture fails: no runs gives an error or stops before the give-up time; a run that appears late is not approved; some approved and some failing gives an error; none approvable gives no error; a run that appears after the give-up time is approved, or the loop runs past it; a run of a fork or of another head is approved.

plan.intent: den PR 3 of AEC task M (Chorus f4bbad07, bead aec-16x.2) adds two optional parts to .dagger/modules/ci. Part j: the setting approveBotRuns (default false) and the function approve-bot-runs. The function approves the pull_request runs that wait for approval (action_required) on a head that a job pushed with its GITHUB_TOKEN, with POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{id}/approve (actions: write). It looks again until a quiet period follows the last approval, or until a give-up time passes. It fails only when runs waited and it approved none. It never approves a run of a fork. Part k: the setting jobKinds, a YAML table that gives each job of .github/workflows a kind (CHECK, AGENT, GITHUB, SCAN, or LEGACY with its recorded exceptions), and the checks ci:workflow-isolation and ci:workflow-isolation-rules. They are a port of the AEC checks docs:workflow-isolation and docs:workflow-isolation-rule, with the 55 AEC rule cases as fixtures. With an empty jobKinds, the check is off. The dagger.toml of den does not change, so the behavior of den does not change. The AEC copy stays in place.
